### Module 08 - Reproducible Research & Deployment

# Shiny Dashboards

***
**Learning objectives**
- Build a multi-tab clinical analytics Shiny dashboard
- Use `bindCache()` and `reactiveValues()` for performance
- Create interactive filters, KPI metrics, and downloadable tables
- Implement patient risk alerting with adjustable thresholds
- Apply authentication and multi-page navigation patterns
- Deploy Shiny apps via Docker, shinyapps.io, and Posit Connect

**Estimated time:** 3 hours | **Level:** Intermediate | **Libraries:** `shiny`, `shinydashboard`, `ggplot2`, `tidymodels`

## 1. Setup & Synthetic Dashboard Dataset


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(pROC)
library(rsample)
library(xgboost)
library(fs)

mod08_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod08")
app_dir <- file.path(mod08_dir, "shiny_app")
dir.create(file.path(app_dir, "data", "processed"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

col_blue <- "#2563EB"
col_red  <- "#DC2626"
col_green <- "#16A34A"
col_gold <- "#D4A017"
col_purple <- "#B47CC7"

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line        = element_line(colour = "grey40")
    )
)

set.seed(42)
N <- 3000
sigmoid <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
df <- tibble(
  patient_id = sprintf("PT-%05d", seq_len(N) - 1),
  age        = as.integer(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 60, 15), 18), 90)),
  sex        = sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52)),
  payer      = sample(
    c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay"),
    N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.10)
  ),
  unit       = sample(c("Cardiology", "Pulmonology", "Medicine", "Surgery"), N, replace = TRUE),
  los_days   = as.integer(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30)),
  diabetes   = rbinom(N, 1, 0.35),
  hf         = rbinom(N, 1, 0.22),
  copd       = rbinom(N, 1, 0.18)
)
logit <- -3.2 + 0.6 * df$hf + 0.5 * df$diabetes + 0.02 * (df$age - 60) +
  0.2 * as.integer(df$los_days > 7)
df$readmit_prob <- sigmoid(logit)
df$readmitted   <- rbinom(N, 1, df$readmit_prob)
df$admit_date   <- seq(as.POSIXct("2023-01-01"), by = "6 hours", length.out = N)
saveRDS(df, file.path(app_dir, "data", "processed", "features.rds"))
write_csv(df, file.path(app_dir, "data", "processed", "features.csv"))
cat(sprintf("Dashboard dataset: %d x %d | Readmission: %.1f%%\n",
            nrow(df), ncol(df), mean(df$readmitted) * 100))
```

## 2. Shiny Architecture for Clinical Dashboards

```
app.R                    <- Single-file entry point
# or
ui.R + server.R          <- Multi-file Shiny
R/
  model.R                <- load_model(), predict_risk()
  data.R                 <- load_data(), filter_data()
  plots.R                <- reusable ggplot2 helpers
```

**Key Shiny concepts for clinical apps:**
- `bindCache()` / `reactive()`: cache expensive data loads (invalidate on input change)
- `reactiveValues()`: persist user selections across tabs
- `sidebarPanel()`: filters that update all tabs simultaneously
- `shinydashboard::valueBox()` / KPI cards with delta indicators
- `downloadHandler()`: export high-risk patient lists to CSV

## 3. Complete app.R


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
SHINY_APP <- paste(
  c(
    "# app.R -- Clinical Readmission Dashboard",
    "library(shiny)",
    "library(ggplot2)",
    "library(dplyr)",
    "library(readr)",
    "library(pROC)",
    "",
    "FEATURES_PATH <- 'data/processed/features.rds'",
    "",
    "ui <- fluidPage(",
    "  titlePanel('30-Day Readmission Analytics Dashboard'),",
    "  sidebarLayout(",
    "    sidebarPanel(",
    "      h3('Filters'),",
    "      hr(),",
    "      checkboxGroupInput(",
    "        'units', 'Hospital Unit',",
    "        choices = c('Cardiology', 'Pulmonology', 'Medicine', 'Surgery'),",
    "        selected = c('Cardiology', 'Pulmonology', 'Medicine', 'Surgery')",
    "      ),",
    "      sliderInput('age_range', 'Age Range', min = 18, max = 90, value = c(30, 80)),",
    "      sliderInput(",
    "        'risk_threshold', 'Risk Alert Threshold',",
    "        min = 0.10, max = 0.50, value = 0.25, step = 0.01",
    "      ),",
    "      helpText('Flag patients above this predicted readmission probability'),",
    "      uiOutput('alert_badge'),",
    "      width = 3",
    "    ),",
    "    mainPanel(",
    "      fluidRow(",
    "        column(3, uiOutput('kpi_n')),",
    "        column(3, uiOutput('kpi_rate')),",
    "        column(3, uiOutput('kpi_los')),",
    "        column(3, uiOutput('kpi_high'))",
    "      ),",
    "      tabsetPanel(",
    "        id = 'tabs',",
    "        tabPanel('Overview',",
    "          fluidRow(",
    "            column(6, plotOutput('unit_rates')),",
    "            column(6, plotOutput('risk_dist'))",
    "          )",
    "        ),",
    "        tabPanel('Patient Risk List',",
    "          h4(textOutput('risk_title')),",
    "          downloadButton('download_high_risk', 'Download High-Risk List'),",
    "          hr(),",
    "          DT::dataTableOutput('risk_table')",
    "        ),",
    "        tabPanel('Model Performance',",
    "          h4('Model Performance Metrics'),",
    "          uiOutput('kpi_auc'),",
    "          plotOutput('roc_plot')",
    "        )",
    "      ),",
    "      width = 9",
    "    )",
    "  )",
    ")",
    "",
    "server <- function(input, output, session) {",
    "  load_data <- reactive({",
    "    readRDS(FEATURES_PATH)",
    "  }) %>% bindCache(FEATURES_PATH)",
    "",
    "  df_filtered <- reactive({",
    "    load_data() %>%",
    "      filter(unit %in% input$units,",
    "             age >= input$age_range[1],",
    "             age <= input$age_range[2])",
    "  })",
    "",
    "  high_risk <- reactive({",
    "    df_filtered() %>%",
    "      filter(readmit_prob >= input$risk_threshold) %>%",
    "      arrange(desc(readmit_prob))",
    "  })",
    "",
    "  output$kpi_n <- renderUI({",
    "    wellPanel(h3(format(nrow(df_filtered()), big.mark = ',')), p('Total Patients'))",
    "  })",
    "  output$kpi_rate <- renderUI({",
    "    rate <- mean(df_filtered()$readmitted) * 100",
    "    overall <- mean(load_data()$readmitted) * 100",
    "    delta <- rate - overall",
    "    wellPanel(",
    "      h3(sprintf('%.1f%%', rate)),",
    "      p('Readmission Rate'),",
    "      p(sprintf('%+.1fpp vs overall', delta))",
    "    )",
    "  })",
    "  output$kpi_los <- renderUI({",
    "    wellPanel(h3(sprintf('%.1f', mean(df_filtered()$los_days))), p('Mean LOS (days)'))",
    "  })",
    "  output$kpi_high <- renderUI({",
    "    wellPanel(",
    "      h3(format(nrow(high_risk()), big.mark = ',')),",
    "      p('High-Risk Patients')",
    "    )",
    "  })",
    "  output$alert_badge <- renderUI({",
    "    n <- nrow(high_risk())",
    "    div(style = 'background:#DC2626;color:white;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;text-align:center;',",
    "        h2(n), p('High Risk Alerts'))",
    "  })",
    "  output$unit_rates <- renderPlot({",
    "    unit_rates <- df_filtered() %>%",
    "      group_by(unit) %>%",
    "      summarise(rate = mean(readmitted) * 100, .groups = 'drop')",
    "    ggplot(unit_rates, aes(unit, rate)) +",
    "      geom_col(fill = '#2563EB', alpha = 0.85) +",
    "      labs(title = 'Readmission Rate by Unit', y = 'Rate (%)', x = NULL) +",
    "      theme_minimal()",
    "  })",
    "  output$risk_dist <- renderPlot({",
    "    ggplot(df_filtered(), aes(readmit_prob)) +",
    "      geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = '#2563EB', alpha = 0.85, colour = 'white') +",
    "      geom_vline(xintercept = input$risk_threshold, linetype = 'dashed') +",
    "      labs(title = 'Risk Score Distribution', x = 'Predicted probability', y = 'Count') +",
    "      theme_minimal()",
    "  })",
    "  output$risk_title <- renderText({",
    "    sprintf('High-Risk Patients (probability >= %.0f%%)', input$risk_threshold * 100)",
    "  })",
    "  output$risk_table <- DT::renderDataTable({",
    "    high_risk() %>%",
    "      select(patient_id, age, unit, los_days, readmit_prob)",
    "  }, options = list(pageLength = 15, order = list(list(4, 'desc'))))",
    "  output$download_high_risk <- downloadHandler(",
    "    filename = function() 'high_risk_patients.csv',",
    "    content = function(file) readr::write_csv(high_risk(), file)",
    "  )",
    "  output$kpi_auc <- renderUI({",
    "    d <- df_filtered()",
    "    auc <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(d$readmitted, d$readmit_prob, quiet = TRUE))",
    "    wellPanel(h3(sprintf('%.3f', auc)), p('AUC-ROC'))",
    "  })",
    "  output$roc_plot <- renderPlot({",
    "    d <- df_filtered()",
    "    roc_obj <- pROC::roc(d$readmitted, d$readmit_prob, quiet = TRUE)",
    "    roc_df <- data.frame(fpr = 1 - roc_obj$specificities, tpr = roc_obj$sensitivities)",
    "    ggplot(roc_df, aes(fpr, tpr)) +",
    "      geom_line(colour = '#DC2626', linewidth = 1.1) +",
    "      geom_abline(linetype = 'dashed') +",
    "      labs(x = '1 - Specificity', y = 'Sensitivity', title = 'ROC Curve') +",
    "      theme_minimal()",
    "  })",
    "}",
    "",
    "shinyApp(ui, server)"
  ),
  collapse = "\n"
)

cat("Shiny application code (app.R):\n")
```

## 4. Dashboard Preview (ggplot2 simulation)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Demonstrate Shiny component patterns without running the server
set.seed(42)
split <- initial_split(df, prop = 0.8, strata = readmitted)
train <- training(split)
test  <- testing(split)
feat <- c("age", "los_days", "diabetes", "hf", "copd")
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(train[feat]), label = train$readmitted)
bst <- xgb.train(
  params = list(objective = "binary:logistic", max_depth = 4, eta = 0.05,
                eval_metric = "auc"),
  data = dtrain, nrounds = 200, verbose = 0
)
df$readmit_prob <- predict(bst, as.matrix(df[feat]))
prob_te <- predict(bst, as.matrix(test[feat]))
auc <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(test$readmitted, prob_te, quiet = TRUE))

kpi_data <- tibble(
  label = c("Total Patients", "Readmission Rate", "Mean LOS", "High Risk (>25%)", "Model AUC"),
  value = c(
    format(nrow(df), big.mark = ","),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", mean(df$readmitted) * 100),
    sprintf("%.1f days", mean(df$los_days)),
    format(sum(df$readmit_prob > 0.25), big.mark = ","),
    sprintf("%.3f", auc)
  ),
  col = c(col_blue, col_red, col_green, col_gold, col_purple)
)
p_kpi <- ggplot(kpi_data, aes(label, 1, fill = col)) +
  geom_tile(alpha = 0.25, colour = kpi_data$col, linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = value, colour = col), fontface = "bold", size = 5, vjust = -0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), colour = "grey40", size = 3, vjust = 1.6) +
  scale_fill_identity() + scale_colour_identity() +
  labs(title = "KPI Header Row") +
  theme_void() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 11))

unit_r <- df %>%
  group_by(unit) %>%
  summarise(rate = mean(readmitted) * 100, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(col = if_else(rate > mean(df$readmitted) * 100, col_red, col_blue))
p_a <- ggplot(unit_r, aes(unit, rate, fill = col)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, colour = "white") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(df$readmitted) * 100, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  labs(y = "Readmission rate (%)", title = "Tab 1: Rate by Unit") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

p_b <- ggplot(df, aes(readmit_prob, fill = factor(readmitted,
                   labels = c("Not readmitted", "Readmitted")))) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 25, alpha = 0.6,
                 position = "identity") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(col_blue, col_red)) +
  labs(x = "Predicted probability", y = "Density",
       title = "Tab 1: Risk Score Distribution", fill = NULL)

roc_obj <- pROC::roc(test$readmitted, prob_te, quiet = TRUE)
roc_df <- tibble(fpr = 1 - roc_obj$specificities, tpr = roc_obj$sensitivities)
p_c <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(fpr, tpr)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = tpr), fill = col_red, alpha = 0.10) +
  geom_line(colour = col_red, linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "1-Specificity", y = "Sensitivity",
       title = sprintf("Tab 3: Model Performance (AUC=%.3f)", auc))

preview <- p_kpi / (p_a | p_b | p_c) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Shiny Dashboard Preview: Clinical Readmission Analytics")
print(preview)
```

## 5. Advanced Shiny Patterns


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ADVANCED_PATTERNS <- paste(
  c(
    "# Pattern 1: Caching for expensive computations",
    "load_scores <- reactive({",
    "  df <- readRDS(features_path)",
    "  model <- readRDS(model_path)",
    "  predict(model, as.matrix(df[FEATURES]))",
    "}) %>% bindCache(features_path, model_path)",
    "",
    "# Pattern 2: reactiveValues for multi-tab apps",
    "rv <- reactiveValues(selected_patient = NULL)",
    "observeEvent(input$risk_table_rows_selected, {",
    "  rv$selected_patient <- high_risk()[input$risk_table_rows_selected, ]",
    "})",
    "",
    "# Pattern 3: Real-time updates with invalidateLater",
    "output$processed <- renderText({",
    "  invalidateLater(500, session)",
    "  paste('Patients Processed', isolate(rv$count))",
    "})",
    "",
    "# Pattern 4: plotly for interactive charts",
    "library(plotly)",
    "output$scatter <- renderPlotly({",
    "  ggplot(df, aes(age, readmit_prob, colour = unit,",
```

```{.r .cell-code}
# Exercise 5 — Alert count simulation
RISK_THRESHOLD <- 0.25
high_risk_count <- sum(df$readmit_prob >= RISK_THRESHOLD)
high_risk_pct   <- high_risk_count / nrow(df) * 100

alert_df <- tibble(x = 0.5, y = 0.6, n = high_risk_count)
p_alert <- ggplot(alert_df, aes(x, y)) +
  annotate("point", x = 0.5, y = 0.6, size = 40, colour = col_red) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.6, label = high_risk_count,
           colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 8) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.28, label = "High Risk Alerts", size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.15,
           label = sprintf("(>%.0f%% predicted readmission)", RISK_THRESHOLD * 100),
           colour = "grey40", size = 3) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Shiny Sidebar Alert Badge") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8f9fa", colour = NA))
print(p_alert)
```
